summary: Preinstall hook downloads Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated 727KB Bun-only payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs is itself obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style hex-mangled identifiers (import _0x488df8 from "fs"; import _0x52943e from "https"; import _0x548d91 from "zlib") and per-function proxy maps that hide a straightforward flow: at install time it fetches a platform-specific Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (bun-v1.3.13), extracts and chmods the Bun executable in a tempdir, and invokes it via execFileSync against the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB Bun-CJS bundle (header '// @bun @bun-cjs') with obfuscator.io-style string-array rotation (function WV8StW shuffles a large mixed literal array) and hex-mangled identifiers; it is only reachable via the downloaded Bun runtime, bypassing Node-based scanners. The package's declared purpose is a GraphQL config helper, which has no need for a Bun-compiled payload. This is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: Bun is fetched not to run the package's own declared functionality but to execute an obfuscated bundled payload that would not run under Node.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
